note: 周考题库。每次周考一条，papers 是每天发的卷子（第1–5天）。卷子里的内容放两种地方：items 放单词/句子（en + zh，网站自动出 英→中、中→英 选择题；kind 可写 word 或 sent，不写时按单词数自动判断）；questions 放卷子上的原题（q 题干、options 选项、answer 正确选项的序号，从 0 开始；explain 可写解析）。考试默认从本周全部卷子里抽 30 题。

papers.title: 第1天

questions.q: The hydraulic pump needs repairing at once. According to the statement, what needs repairing?
questions.explain: 液压泵需要立即修理。need doing = 需要被……

questions.q: In this sentence, "The team prepares for work." "Work" is the ______.
questions.explain: The team 是主语（subject），prepares 是谓语动词（verb），work 是宾语（object）

questions.q: Rub the area with lint-free cloth that is moist with solvent. According to the instruction, how to rub the area?
options: With lint-free cloth that is moist with solvent
With cloth that is moist with water
questions.explain: lint-free cloth 不起毛的布；moist with solvent 用溶剂浸湿的

questions.q: Rewrite the sentence "Attach “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” to spoiler lever." by using a passive voice.
options: “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” are attached to spoiler lever.
“DO NOT TOUCH flaps” attach to spoiler lever.
“DO NOT TOUCH flaps” are attaching to spoiler lever.
questions.explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词，原来的宾语 “DO NOT TOUCH flaps” 变成主语

questions.q: ______ is used when our focus is on the object of the action.
questions.explain: 关注动作的对象（而不是谁做的）时用被动语态

questions.q: Rewrite the sentence "Disconnect the electrical connectors." by using a passive voice.
questions.explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词；electrical connectors 电连接器

questions.q: ______ calls attention to methods and procedures that must be followed precisely to avoid injury to persons.
questions.explain: Warning（警告）防止人员受伤；Caution（警戒）防止设备损坏；Note 是补充说明

questions.q: CUT OFF THE SHARP POINT OF STUD FASTENERS IN AREAS WHERE PERSONS CAN TOUCH THEM. SHARP FASTENERS CAN CAUSE INJURIES. This warning suggests that ______.
options: you should CUT OFF THE SHARP POINT OF STUD FASTENERS IN AREAS WHERE PERSONS CAN TOUCH THEM.
you should NOT TOUCH ANY STUD FASTENERS.
SHARP FASTENERS CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE EQUIPMENT.
questions.explain: 在人能碰到的地方，把螺柱紧固件的尖头切掉，因为尖的紧固件会伤人

questions.q: The suggestion of the "CAUTION: DO NOT RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH. THIS WILL CAUSE SCRATCHES AND AN ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE." is ______.
options: DO NOT RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH.
RUB THE PLASTIC SURFACES WITH A DRY CLOTH.
USE A DRY CLOTH TO REMOVE THE ELECTROSTATIC CHARGE.
questions.explain: 不要用干布擦塑料表面，会造成刮痕和静电（scratches and an electrostatic charge）

questions.q: "CAUTION: MAKE SURE THE POLARITY IS CORRECT TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT." means ______.
options: 警戒：确保极性正确防止设备损坏。
警告：确保极性正确防止人员受伤。
警戒：极性错误不会损坏设备。
questions.explain: CAUTION = 警戒，针对设备损坏；WARNING = 警告，针对人员受伤。polarity 极性

questions.q: Find the action word in the instruction "Assemble the ring spring assembly."
questions.explain: 句首 Assemble 是动词（装配），句末 assembly 是名词（组件）；ring spring 环形弹簧

questions.q: The negative form of the sentence "Pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle." is ______.
options: Don't pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
Not pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
Doesn't pull out the No. 1 Engine fire handle.
questions.explain: 祈使句的否定 = Don't / Do not + 动词原形

questions.q: Install the screws to attach the valve to the skin. What's the usage of the screws?
questions.explain: 装螺钉是为了固定活门（attach the valve）

questions.q: According to the instruction, "Stow a mask/regulator at each mask storage box." where shall we put the mask?
questions.explain: stow 存放；每个面罩存放盒里放一个面罩/调节器

questions.q: According to the instruction, "Decrease the pressure steadily." how to make the pressure low?
questions.explain: steadily 平稳地、逐渐地

questions.q: If the component is not clean, discard it. According to the instruction, you should ______.
options: throw it away when it is dirty.
throw it away when it is clean.
clean it and install it again.
questions.explain: discard = throw away 丢弃。部件不干净就丢掉

questions.q: Wash your hands before you service other systems. According to the instruction, you should ______ firstly.
questions.explain: before 前面的动作先做：先洗手，再维护其他系统

questions.q: After the surface looks fully clean, remove the solvent with a mixed detergent. According to the instruction, ______ firstly.
options: make sure the surface looks fully clean
questions.explain: After 后面的动作先发生：先确保表面完全干净，再用调好的清洁剂去掉溶剂

questions.q: Do the above steps again until the area is fully clean. According to the instruction, when shall we stop doing the above steps again?
options: When the area is fully clean
After we do the steps one more time
questions.explain: until 直到：重复上面的步骤，直到区域完全干净

questions.q: Do not put your head in the fuel tank access hole unless you have the correct respirator on. According to the instruction, ______ is correct.
options: 你可以把头钻进油箱入口，即使你没有戴上了面罩。
你可以把头钻进油箱入口，没有戴上面罩也没关系。
如果你要把头钻进油箱入口，你必须正确地戴上了面罩。
questions.explain: unless 除非：只有戴上正确的呼吸器（respirator）才能把头伸进油箱入口

papers.note: Technical English of Aircraft Maintenance for General Mechanics Exercise - Day 1。正确答案按老师给的；第13、20题是老师的原选项，其余题的错误选项是整理时补的
